prompt: Edit the supplied Song cargo courtyard sprite into one NEW Liao-Jin northern freight-protection courtyard for tianshu/default, id bld_kit_liao_jin_north_biaoju. Preserve its restrained realistic art style, detail density, exact orthographic camera, thin footprint, compact one-courtyard layout and transparent background. Replace the southern vegetation with bare compacted-earth court; use buff earth-plaster walls and gray stone footings, dark unpainted timber, simple unglazed gray roof tiles with restrained early-medieval eaves, no Ming-Qing ornament. Rear single-story reception hall, open side storehouse containing packed bales and crates, a small two-wheel wooden freight handcart inside the courtyard, modest entry gate facing screen lower left. It represents an unnamed game cargo-protection business (original extension), not a claim that a historical branded escort agency existed. No plaque or banner. Footprint14m east-west by11m north-south,14:11 ratio; strict 2:1 dimetric ground plane yaw45 elevation30, ground axis slopes +0.5 and -0.5, parallel edges do not converge. Keep all three left/front/right floor contact corners clearly readable; do not thicken the base. Light upper-left, short soft contact shadow lower-right. Complete isolated image with true RGBA transparency and ample margins. No people, animals, text, symbols, flags, background, halo, vignette, roads, landscape, gold roofs, modern objects, watermark or checkerboard.
